behavior.arguments: rdi = first string base; rdx = second string base; rsi = length, must be exactly 3. No other argument is read and no field is written.

branch_targets.0x151a52c: fail path (xor eax,eax; ret) reached from the length gate (rsi != 3) and from any folded-pair mismatch

edges.fold_boundary_mismatch: @BC vs `bc returns 0 (0x40 and 0x60 are both outside A-Z and differ)
edges.non_alpha_passthrough: A!C vs a!c returns 1 (non-alpha bytes pass through unchanged)

behavior.entry_shape: Opens with cmp $0x3,%rsi (NOT endbr64); straight-line with conditional early exits (jne to the fail path); two rets (success sete + ret, fail xor + ret); zero calls inside.
behavior.fold_idiom_disclosure: A whole-.text scan for the (cmp imm 0x1a + setb) fold idiom finds 13 FDEs (size <= 400B) using case-folding somewhere, including this window (6 folds = 3 positions x 2 strings) — e.g. 0x29a4970 (12 folds, 314B), 0x13d94c0 / 0x1635560 / 0x284b430 (4 folds each, 283B), 0x151aff0 (2 folds, 261B, immediately before the caller FDE). Those are larger functions that USE folding; none is a pure fixed-length-3 equality window, and none byte-matches this window. The idiom's recurrence elsewhere does not make this window a population member.
behavior.peer_distinction: This window sits in the #1033 region scan (+-0x3000 around helper 0x151cba0, ~0x2700 away), but its domain is unrelated to the peer's integer result projection (string equality vs integer math) — it is a neighbour by address only, not a sibling of the peer's claim. The peer lane is not claimed here.
behavior.return_rule: rax = 1 iff rsi == 3 and fold([rdi+i]) == fold([rdx+i]) for i = 0,1,2, where fold(b) = b | 0x20 if 'A' <= b <= 'Z' else b; else rax = 0.
behavior.twin_guard: Full claimed-body byte-compare top match is only 8/127 vs 0x4ebf860 (round-15 UTF-8 encode, KNOWN) — NOT a twin. Byte-compare vs the avoid-list string compares 0x1a6af10 / 0x41d60c0 is 4/143 each — NOT twins: those are byte-wise lexicographic compares with a bswap tail and no folding, a different rule.

coordinate_system: ELF virtual addresses, without a guessed loader or Ghidra rebase. The ELF section table maps .text with file offset = VA - 0x1000; the retained .eh_frame has equal file offset and VA. The tools resolve sections rather than assuming one global VA/file-offset relationship.

incoming_pattern_scan.note: Byte-pattern scan over the full .text section (70,370,352 bytes) for e8 sites whose rel32 lands on the window start; exactly two sites found, both inside the single caller FDE [0x151b100, 0x151b6a3) and independently resolved to the window start by objdump's caller disassembly. This is explicitly not a complete xref census: indirect calls, tail jumps, and PLT references are out of scope for the scan.
incoming_pattern_scan.relocation_note: No R_X86_64_RELATIVE record in any .rela.* section names this window as addend (full-section scan: 80,022 .rela.dyn + 278 .rela.plt entries).
